refined_trace: ASR over the full video gives a transcript anchor for the character name: at 85.035–85.935s the segment reads "Have you found anything, Pando?" and later at 256.759–259.521s it reads "Panda was a huge misrepresentation of who I am." This supports that the asked character is Panda/Pando, but it does not support the original 1:26 timestamp.

For the visual trait, frame_retriever returns candidate frames at 88.0s, 262.0s, and 268.0s; these are only candidate moments, so I use the frame-level spatial grounding results rather than the retrieval rank itself.

On frame_88.00.png at 88.0s, spatial_grounder detects a "character wearing glasses" with bbox [325, 122, 710, 997] at confidence 0.99, and its description says: "A brown bear character wearing glasses and a striped sweater stands in the center of the frame, in front of a desk with a laptop."

The other checked frames do not override that: spatial_grounder on frame_262.00.png at 262.0s and frame_268.00.png at 268.0s detects a "character wearing a bow tie" on the right side, while also describing another nearby character as not wearing glasses or a bow tie. Since Step 2 provided these only as candidate frames and Step 3 most directly grounds the asked character near a desk/computer at 88.0s, the supported visible characteristic for Panda is glasses.
